name: dotnet-msix  
Packages MSIX apps. Creation, signing, Store submission, App Installer sideload, auto-update. MSIX packaging pipeline for .NET desktop apps: package creation from csproj (`WindowsPackageType`) and WAP projects, certificate signing (self-signed for development, trusted CA for production, Microsoft Store signing), distribution channels (Microsoft Store submission, App Installer sideloading, enterprise deployment via SCCM/Intune), auto-update config (App Installer XML, version checking, differential updates), MSIX bundle multi-arch (`.msixbundle`), and CI/CD MSIX build steps.  
Version assumptions: Windows App SDK 1.6+; Win10 build 19041+ for MSIX with Windows App SDK; Win10 build 1709+ for App Installer auto-update protocol; .NET 8.0+.

Modern WinUI 3/Windows App SDK apps produce MSIX directly from app `.csproj` without WAP.
